description: Resolves CSS for a selector by querying a live running browser via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Returns exact computed styles and every matched rule in cascade order — no static analysis, no heuristics, confidence is always exact. Requires Chrome or any Chromium browser (Edge, Brave, Arc) running with --remote-debugging-port=9222. Use this when you need ground truth. Fall back to resolve_styles when no browser is running.

port.description: CDP port (default: 9222). Change if you started Chrome with a different port.

selector.description: CSS selector to resolve against the live DOM, e.g. ".btn.primary", "#header a"

tabUrl.description: Optional URL substring to target a specific tab. If omitted, uses the first available tab.

name: live_resolve
